title: Revenue Operations Analyst
description:
About Augment

Logistics is broken. Let's fix it.

We are a team of engineers, product designers, and customer champions building Augie, Augment's AI teammate for supply chain. Augie reasons and acts like a seasoned operator, automating the busywork of quoting, dispatch, tracking, billing, and more for freight brokers, 3PLs, for-hire carriers, private fleets, and distributors.

Our team has scaled billion-dollar companies, built delightful products, and powered billions in commerce. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and want to define how AI reshapes supply chain, apply today.

Overview

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst to join our growing RevOps team. You'll own our deal desk, support territory planning, and run the reporting our sales leaders rely on every week as we grow from 12 AEs to more than 20. You'll also keep our data clean and handle the day-to-day work behind forecasting, quota administration, and commission calculations. This role reports to the Director of Revenue Operations.

Our GTM Motion

Our motion is outbound-led. SDRs prospect and qualify freight brokers, 3PLs, for-hire carriers, private fleets, and distributors before AEs run discovery and close. We sell across Mid-Market, Enterprise, and Strategic segments, with six-figure ARR deals and buying committees that span operations, IT, and finance. Your deal desk and reporting work needs to hold up to that complexity.

What You'll Do

  • Own the deal desk: review pricing, discounts, and non-standard terms, route approvals, and make sure every closed deal is booked correctly

  • Partner with Sales, Finance, and Legal so quotes and contracts move fast without surprises

  • Support territory planning: model coverage and capacity, manage account assignments, and keep regions and segments up to date as we roll them out, starting with Distribution

  • Own sales reporting: run the weekly forecast and pipeline reports leadership uses to call the quarter, and build dashboards for pipeline, conversion, bookings, and AE and SDR performance

  • Report contracted ARR and live, billing ARR side by side, and work with Finance so the numbers tie out

  • Keep HubSpot clean and reliable: own data quality, required fields, account ownership, and deal hygiene

  • Calculate commissions and support quota tracking, working with the Director and Finance

  • Help onboard new hires to our sales tools and processes, and document how things work

What We're Looking For

  • 2 to 4 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Deal Desk at a B2B SaaS company

  • Hands-on experience running or supporting a deal desk, including pricing approvals and contract review

  • Experience supporting territory planning or account assignment

  • Hands-on CRM admin experience. We're on HubSpot, and experience there is a strong plus

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, and comfort with SQL or a BI tool

  • A detail person who cares when the numbers don't match and digs in until they do

  • Clear communication with sales leaders and reps, including pushing back when the data says otherwise

Bonus Points For

  • Experience in logistics, freight, trucking, distribution, or supply chain tech

  • Experience administering commission plans or quota models

  • Familiarity with Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Seamless.ai, Clay, or BI platforms

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive Salary + Stock Options

  • Comprehensive Health, Vision, and Dental Benefits

  • Flexible PTO

  • Monthly stipend

At Augment, we set out to create a fully autonomous AI platform that streamlines operations and reclaims the human element in logistics. Our founders recognized a pattern: talented professionals were stuck handling manual data entry, phone calls, and repetitive tasks, instead of focusing on high-impact problem-solving and strategic decision-making.

That insight became our missionâto free logistics professionals from busywork so they can focus on what truly drives business growth. Augment isnât just about efficiency; itâs about transforming an entire industry by empowering teams with AI-driven solutions that make logistics smarter, faster, and more adaptive.

title: Werkstudent / Praktikant (m/w/d) – Product Management, Operations & International Expansion
description:
Über STRIVE

STRIVE Nutrition ist eine wachsende Premium-Marke für pflanzliche Bio-Proteine und hochwertige Supplements.

Unser Anspruch ist es, außergewöhnlich gute Produkte mit kompromisslosem Qualitätsanspruch zu entwickeln – von der Auswahl der Rohstoffe über Rezeptur und Produktion bis zu Verpackung und Markteinführung.

Wir vertreiben unsere Produkte insbesondere über Amazon und unseren eigenen Onlineshop und befinden uns aktuell in einer besonders spannenden Wachstumsphase: Unser Sortiment wird deutlich erweitert, bestehende Produkte werden weiterentwickelt, das Design komplett überarbeitet, neue Lieferketten aufgebaut und gleichzeitig bereiten wir unsere internationale Expansion vor.

Für diese dynamische Wachstumsphase suchen wir engagierte Verstärkung in zentraler Funktion.

Deine Rolle

Als Werkstudent oder Praktikant im Bereich Product Management, Operations & International Expansion arbeitest du direkt mit den Gründern an den operativen Grundlagen unseres Wachstums.

Du begleitest den gesamten Weg eines Produkts: von der Suche nach geeigneten Rohstoffen und Lieferanten über Preisverhandlungen und Produktionsplanung bis hin zu Verpackung, Qualitätsmanagement und internationaler Markteinführung.

Damit erhältst du einen ungewöhnlich umfassenden Einblick darin, wie eine physische Consumer Brand tatsächlich aufgebaut und skaliert wird.

Deine Aufgaben

Einkauf & Supplier Management

  • Identifikation geeigneter Rohstoff-, Verpackungs- und Produktionspartner in Deutschland, Europa und international sowie Einholen und Bewerten von Angeboten

  • Kommunikation mit bestehenden und potenziellen Lieferanten

  • Unterstützung bei Preis-, Mengen- und Konditionsverhandlungen

  • Aufbau und Pflege einer strukturierten Lieferanten- und Beschaffungsübersicht

Produktentwicklung & Launch Management

  • Operative Begleitung neuer Produkte von der ersten Idee bis zur Markteinführung

  • Koordination von Produktmustern, -Analysen und Testproduktionen

  • Unterstützung bei Rohstoff- und Verpackungsentscheidungen

  • Nachhalten von Timelines und offenen Punkten bei Produkt-Launches

  • Schnittstellenarbeit zwischen Produktentwicklung, Design, Produktion und Logistik

Produktions- & Bedarfsplanung

  • Unterstützung bei der Planung unserer Produktionsmengen und Produktionszeitpunkte

  • Abstimmung von Rohstoffbeständen, Verpackungsmaterialien, Produktionskapazitäten und erwarteter Nachfrage mit dem Team und unseren Partnern

  • Überwachung wichtiger Liefer- und Produktionstermine und Unterstützung beim Lagerbestandsmanagement

  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Forecasting- und Planungsprozesse

Business Operations

  • Analyse, Optimierung und KI-gestützte Automatisierung bestehender Prozesse

  • Aufbau von Reports, Kalkulationen und Entscheidungsgrundlagen

  • Identifikation von Kosten- und Effizienzpotenzialen entlang unserer Supply Chain

  • Übernahme eigener Projekte mit direktem Einfluss auf das operative Geschäft

International Expansion

  • Mitarbeit bei der Vorbereitung neuer Markteintritte, insbesondere unserer USA-Expansion

  • Recherche regulatorischer, logistischer und operativer Anforderungen

  • Koordination mit internationalen Herstellern, Lieferanten und Dienstleistern

  • Mitarbeit an Business Cases und Entscheidungsgrundlagen für neue Märkte und Produkte sowie Bewertung verschiedener Produktions-, Fulfillment- und Beschaffungsoptionen

Was du mitbringen solltest

Für diese Position suchen wir vor allem jemanden, der gerne strukturiert Probleme löst, Verantwortung übernimmt und Dinge zu Ende bringt.

Must-haves:

  • Du studierst einen wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen, technischen oder naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang, mindestens im 3. Semester, und gehörst mit deinen akademischen Leistungen zu den Top 30 % deines Jahrgangs.

  • Du hast bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen gesammelt, egal in welcher Branche

  • Du hast du Spaß an quantitativen Analysen und wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick

  • Du zeichnest dich durch hohe Eigeninitiative aus, hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen und suchst aktiv nach besseren Alternativen

  • Du kommunizierst klar und verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Nice-to-haves:

  • Du hast du bereits erste Erfahrungen mit KI-Software (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT etc.) und hast idealerweise bereits eine App gebaut oder Prozesse automatisiert

  • Du konntest bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen im Umfeld eines Scale-ups, einer Managementberatung oder einer Software- oder Marketingagentur sammeln.

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Excel bzw. Google Sheets

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und unmittelbare Einbindung in wichtige Unternehmensentscheidungen

  • Ein außergewöhnlich breiter Einblick in Einkauf, Produktion, Supply Chain, Produktentwicklung und internationale Expansion

  • Verantwortung und eigene Projekte vom ersten Tag an, statt klassischer Praktikantenaufgaben

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, eigene Verbesserungsvorschläge unmittelbar umzusetzen

  • Homeoffice, Flexible Arbeitszeiten und gute Vereinbarkeit mit deinem Studium

  • Eine sehr steile Lernkurve in einem erfahrenen Team an der Schnittstelle zwischen Entrepreneurship, Operations und Strategie

  • Die Möglichkeit, bei guter Zusammenarbeit langfristig Verantwortung bei STRIVE zu übernehmen

  • Und natürlich: ausreichend STRIVE-Produkte für dich

Was die Stelle besonders macht

Du wirst erleben, wie aus einer Produktidee ein tatsächlich produziertes und verkauftes Produkt wird – und an vielen der entscheidenden Schritte selbst beteiligt sein.

An einem Tag vergleichst du Angebote internationaler Lieferanten, am nächsten planst du gemeinsam mit uns eine Produktion und anschließend analysierst du, wie wir ein neues Produkt oder einen neuen Markt operativ erschließen können.

Wenn du verstehen möchtest, wie man eine physische Consumer Brand von Grund auf aufbaut und international skaliert, bietet diese Rolle dir einen außergewöhnlich tiefen Einblick.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - German Speaking
description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $150M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

We are looking for a versatile and highly skilled German-speaking Forward Deployed Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will combine strong technical abilities with excellent communication skills, working directly with customers to ensure they maximize the value of HappyRobot’s AI platform. You will be involved in onboarding, implementation, and ongoing support, while also contributing to product development and innovation.


At HappyRobot, there’s no role seniority or hierarchy — we operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You’ll Do

  • Customer-Facing Engineering – Work closely with customers from onboarding to ongoing usage, helping them integrate and optimize our AI solutions.

  • Technical Development – Build new features, MVPs, and scalable solutions that directly impact customer outcomes.

  • Full-Stack Development – Utilize React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python to develop robust applications and tools.

  • AI/ML Applications – Design, implement, and iterate on AI/ML solutions, including LLM prompting, tuning of voices, and transcribers to optimize use cases.

  • Integration & APIs – Manage APIs and integrations with third-party systems to ensure seamless functionality for customers.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to deliver tailored solutions.

  • Iterative Problem-Solving – Continuously iterate and improve AI solutions based on customer feedback and evolving requirements.

  • Project Management – Prioritize and manage multiple projects under tight deadlines while maintaining high-quality results.

Must Have

  • Strong full-stack experience: React, TypeScript, Node.js.

  • Hands-on proficiency in Python.

  • Experience building AI/ML applications, including LLM prompting and tuning.

  • Ability to manage APIs and integrate with third-party systems.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.

  • Founder mindset: highly independent, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

  • Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

  • Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

title: ISA Operations Specialist (f/m/d)
description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

This role will give you the opportunity to play a pivotal part in further establishing our presence in the UK market, work with some of the best technology in the industry, and travel regularly to our Berlin HQ to spend time with the wider operational team, build relationships and take part in team activities.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Act as the subject matter expert for Upvest’s Stocks and Shares ISA transfer processes (cash and in-specie, inbound and outbound, using Equisoft), along with other S&S ISA processes and edge cases including those around APS, oversubscriptions, voids and ISA reporting.

  • Run the daily operational cycle: work exceptions, failed or delayed settlements, rejected and aged transfers, and breaks, and escalate and resolve them within regulatory and client timescales.

  • Build strong relationships with our clients’ operations teams and help them support their end users with ISA-related queries, explaining complex topics clearly to non-specialists.

  • Monitor key settlement and transfer metrics (such as transfer times and ageing) and turn them into insight that supports business decisions and improves performance, including MI for our governance forums.

  • Design and build out operational improvements and lead on automation and AI initiatives that define our UK client experience.

  • Keep operations compliant with the ISA Regulations, HMRC ISA Manager obligations, CASS and our internal policies, identifying and escalating risks to keep operations reliable and secure.

  • Own first-line controls for ISA operations: maintain procedures and documentation, run checks and reconciliations, and support internal and external audits.

  • Support the understanding of corporate actions and income events affecting ISA holdings.

  • Work with Product, Engineering, Brokerage, Compliance, Treasury and other teams to resolve issues and keep processes efficient.

  • Take part in projects that scale our UK settlement and transfer operations, including preparing for the UK move to T+1 settlement.

 

What you bring:

  • At least 3 years of relevant work experience with ISA transfers

  • Familiarity with transfer software such as Equisoft or Origo and exposure to the CREST system

  • Understanding of relevant regulatory frameworks such as CASS, HMRC ISA Manager rules

  • Proven track record of managing teams and driving operational excellence

  • Strong investigative and analytical skills; ability to identify errors

  • Exceptional ability to communicate and foster positive business relationships with both internal and external stakeholders

  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines

  • Fluent in English - both written and verbal

     

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

 

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Architecte SIC PPNR - 3922 H/F
company: Agence de services et de paiement
description:
_______________________

Domaine : Numérique
Nature du poste : Pérenne - PASP003922
Statut : Fonctionnaire cat. A - ouvert aux contractuels
Corps : AAE/IAE/ISIC
Cotation RIFSEEP : G3.B
Cotation Parcours professionnel : 1


Pour les contractuels
Fondement juridique du contrat : L 332-1 du CGFP
Niveau d’études : à partir de Bac + 5
Durée du contrat : jusqu’à 36 mois

Date de vacance de l’emploi : 01/02/2027
Date limite de candidature : 27/12/2026

________________________

Environnement professionnel

L'Agence de services et de paiement (ASP) est un établissement public administratif sous la double tutelle des ministères en charge de l’Agriculture et de l'Emploi. Premier organisme payeur européen des aides agricoles de la Politique agricole commune, l’ASP dispose d’un savoir-faire reconnu en ingénierie administrative, instruction, contrôle, paiement et d’assistance aux utilisateurs de nombreux dispositifs d’aides publiques.

La programmation des Fonds européens 2028-2034 instaure une approche intégrée regroupant l'ensemble des fonds européens au sein d'un Plan de Partenariat National-Régional (PPNR), afin de simplifier leur pilotage. Cette réforme s'accompagne d'une évolution des systèmes d'information nécessaires aux échanges avec la Commission européenne. Le SGAE envisage de confier à l'ASP le rôle d'opérateur technique du futur système d’information (SI)  de coordination nationale, articulé autour d'un système de gestion des déclarations de paiement et d'un système décisionnel de suivi des opérations (7 applicatifs à construire).

Objectifs

Au sein de la Mission PPNR, vous serez responsable de l’architecture technique Data et applicative autour de  3 grands enjeux :

  • optimiser et faire évoluer l’architecture du Lac de données agricoles, tout en garantissant la gouvernance technique et la prise en compte des enjeux de souveraineté numérique;

  • concevoir des architectures applicatives alignées sur les besoins métiers, en structurant la gouvernance des données et en accompagnant les équipes dans leurs cadrages applicatifs;

  • piloter la feuille de route data (modernisation, API, Open data) en collaboration avec les métiers, pour traduire les enjeux opérationnels en solutions techniques robustes.

Missions

  • Expertise technique en infrastructure Big Data : maîtrise des environnements Cloudera CDP. Capacité à auditer, optimiser et faire évoluer l’architecture technique dans un cadre de souveraineté numérique et contre-expertiser les solutions proposées par la MOE

  • Conception d’architectures applicatives métiers : expérience dans le choix et la validation d’architectures pour les applicatifs du SI PPNR, avec une expertise sur l’ingestion, le traitement, l’échanges de données entre applicatifs  et la restitution des données (API, open data)

  • Gouvernance et qualité des données : capacité à définir des règles de qualité, de lignage et de conformité (RGPD, sécurité dans le respect de la PSSI de l’ASP)

  • Rôle de conseil technique et de contre-expertise sur les choix techniques des différents prestataires impliqués sur la construction des blocs applicatifs (modélisation, stockage, orchestration). Validation des architectures proposées.

  • Alignement métier et valorisation des données : Capacité à comprendre les besoins métiers, à les traduire en solutions techniques (pipelines, Modélisation des données et Conception de schémas (MCD, MPD). Contribution à la stratégie data du SI PPNR

Champs relationnel

En interne : Direction des Soutiens Directs Agricoles (DSDA), Direction du Développement Rural et de la Pêche (DDRP), Mission de coordination des organismes payeurs des fonds agricoles (MCFA), Direction Numérique et des Systèmes d’information (DNSI)

En externe : Secrétariat général des affaires européennes (SGAE), Ministère de l’agriculture et de la souveraineté alimentaire, Conseils régionaux, Organismes payeurs français, Auditeurs (français et européens), les maîtrises d’œuvre (MOE) en charge du développement et de l’exploitation du SI PPNR

Savoirs

Data Engineering :

  • Maîtrise de python, PySpark et de SQLPlus (> 5 ans)

  • Connaissance fonctionnelle  et technique (administration) souhaitée du produit Microstrategy

  • Aptitude à challenger la MOE en cas de problème sur le socle (déboguer, agir, tracer, communiquer)

  • Maitrise des SGBDR PostgreSQL et Oracle (sauvegarde, restauration, miroitage)

Architecture data :

  • Solide connaissance des technologies Big Data (Cloudera, Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Hadoop, Hive, Atlas)

  • Capacité à challenger une architecture technique

  • Maîtrise opérationnelle des éléments clés de l'architecture informatique (système, réseau, bases de données, stockage, middleware, chaîne CI/CD)

  • Compétences/expériences avérées en modélisation de données

  • Expérience en MLOps (intégration de modèles IA dans les pipelines data)

  • Maîtrise des architectures cloud et data mesh

Savoir-faire

  • Avoir le sens de l'organisation, anticiper les deadlines, orchestrer les actions

  • Savoir rédiger un document technique

  • Savoir argumenter les propositions techniques et aptitude à partager les connaissances avec les équipes d'architecture et de développement

  • Une connaissance du monde agricole et du secteur public serait un plus

  • Appétence pour le travail collaboratif et les outils innovants

Savoir-être

  • Travailler en équipe

  • Rigueur, autonomie, méthode et sens de l’organisation

  • Capacité à respecter des délais

Conditions particulières d’exercice

Diplôme d'ingénieur, avec au moins 5 à 8 ans d'expérience dans le domaine du développement, et au moins 2 ans d’expérience sur un poste d’architecture applicative

________________________

    Directeur du Lac de données agricoles - DSDA, DDRP & MCFA

title: Cobalt Core Pentester
description:
Who We Are

The Cobalt Core is an exclusive community of security pentesters. We admit a select fraction of applicants, each earning their place through a rigorous vetting process that evaluates technical expertise, professionalism, and track record. Core members are recognized practitioners and researchers who set the standard for offensive security work.

Members actively track emerging vulnerabilities and exploitation techniques, and they regularly publish research, speak at major conferences, and lead open-source initiatives.

If you are an experienced security professional who wants high-impact client engagements alongside peers who share your commitment to the craft, we encourage you to apply.

Please note: this is a freelance, part-time position available only to pentesters residing outside in the USA.

(If you are currently residing in the USA, please apply via Cobalt's US pentester posting.)

Who You Are

  • Based outside of the US
  • Multiple years of hands-on offensive security experience, with demonstrated depth in at least one specialty (e.g., web/API, cloud, mobile, network, or AI/LLM security)
  • Proof of impact, such as CVEs, published research, conference talks, or open-source security tools
  • Recognized by clients and peers for finding high-value flaws and delivering clear, actionable reports
  • A track record of making the teams and engagements you're part of measurably stronger
  • Meticulous about your work, from methodology to the final report

What You'll Do

  • Perform manual penetration testing across the following engagement types: Web, API, Internal/External Network, Cloud Config Review, Desktop, LLM, MCP, Cloud, Mobile, SCR, and Digital Risk Assessments (DRA)
  • Work as part of a pentest team and engage directly with clients
  • Author comprehensive, well-documented assessment reports that serve as reliable reference standards
  • Rigorously find vulnerabilities through manual testing techniques rather than relying on automated scanners
  • Go beyond baseline frameworks like the OWASP Top 10 to uncover complex, chained, and logic-based flaws that automated tools miss
  • Support the broader Core community through mentoring, sharing methodology, or contributing insights from your own research or conference talks

Certifications (a plus, not required)

We give particular weight to advanced, hands-on certifications such as OSCE, OSWE, OSEP, CREST, OSAI,GMOB,GPEN and COAE. Additional other OffSec and SANS certifications are welcome additions as well.

Why You Should Join Us

  • Work alongside some of the strongest security researchers in the industry
  • Test novel attack surfaces, including AI/LLM systems, MCP, and complex cloud environments
  • Join a private community for sharing methodology, research, and techniques
  • Build your reputation through research, talks, and recognition within the Core
  • Set your own hours and choose engagements that fit your expertise
  • Help make the internet more secure, one application at a time
  • Competitive pay for your time and expertise

Application Process

  • Application: This is a selective process, and only strong applicants move forward.
  • Chat with a Cobalt representative: We'll talk through your experience, strengths, and what drives you, and explain how Cobalt works.
  • Technical Skills Assessment: Show us your technical depth and reporting quality.
  • Background Check & ID Verification: We'll complete standard verification before getting you set up.
  • Platform Onboarding: We'll get you set up on the Cobalt platform.
  • Start working on projects.

Applicants need apply only once; applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

title: Founding Full Stack Engineer – AI (m/f/d)
description:
Berlin · Full-time · Start ASAP

About Limetax

Limetax is building the agentic-first accounting and tax group for German SMEs.

We acquire established accounting and tax advisory firms and onboard them to our proprietary agentic platform, combining deep industry expertise with AI-native technology.

Backed by $40m in equity and debt from top-tier investors, we're building and scaling a new kind of accounting & tax group in Germany.

Our founders bring significant experience across M&A, operations, and AI-native technology, having previously built and scaled unicorns, Razor Group and Augustus.

The Role

As a Founding Full Stack Engineer, you'll build the product our tax professionals use every day, from databases and backend services to the interfaces and AI features that bring it together.

Your initial focus will be bookkeeping: understanding how documents become accounting entries, where manual work slows people down, and how software and AI can make the process better.

You'll work directly with tax professionals to understand their workflows, decide what's worth building, and turn ambiguous problems into useful product features. You'll prototype quickly, test with users, and take what works into reliable production.

You'll work closely with our engineering team and founders, with real ownership of the features you ship and how they perform in practice.

What You'll Work On

  • Full-stack Product Engineering. Build complete features across our TypeScript stack, with React on the frontend and NestJS on the backend. Own the user experience, APIs, and data model together.

  • Bookkeeping Workflows. Build systems for document processing, booking proposals, review, and accounting integrations. Make workflows and their exceptions explicit so users and engineers can understand how they work.

  • Applied AI. Build LLM-powered features, agents, and retrieval systems that reduce manual work. Decide where AI adds value, where deterministic logic is needed, and where users should stay in control.

  • Rapid Prototyping. Turn user problems into small, working versions quickly. Use modern development tools, including AI coding tools, to experiment, learn, and improve what you ship.

  • Backend & Data Integrity. Design APIs, relational data models, and integrations with systems such as DATEV. Handle validation, duplicate processing, and failures deliberately.

  • Production Ownership. Take features through testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. Evaluate AI behavior against real examples and investigate failures across the stack.

  • Direct User Feedback. Stay close to German-speaking tax professionals, understand what helps them, and use their feedback to guide the next improvement.

Your Profile

  • You are a strong software engineer. You have shipped full-stack products that real users rely on. You're comfortable writing frontend code and have strong backend, API, SQL, and database design skills.

  • You have strong product intuition. You ask why a problem matters, challenge assumptions, and choose a useful first version. You care about whether people can use what you build and whether it improves their work.

  • You have high agency. You move from an unclear problem to working software, make pragmatic decisions, and take responsibility for your delivery. You enjoy experimenting with new tools and approaches.

  • You make complex workflows understandable. You can explain the process, sketch its states and exceptions when useful, and communicate what changed and how you validated it. You keep this practical and lightweight.

  • You build with AI. You have hands-on experience building features with LLMs, agents, or AI-enabled workflows, and understand their limitations. Experience operating these features in production is a plus.

  • You care about reliability. You know when a quick prototype is enough and what needs to change before users depend on it, especially when handling financial data.

  • You speak professional German and fluent English. You can work directly with our tax advisory teams in German and collaborate with our engineering team in English. You're based in Berlin or willing to relocate for on-site work.

Why Limetax

  • Immediate operational impact. Build software that directly changes how accounting and tax work gets done.

  • End-to-end ownership. Take features from understanding the workflow through implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement.

  • Tight feedback loops. Work directly with the people using your product, with access to real workflows, documents, and domain expertise.

  • Applied AI in production. Solve problems where accuracy, reliability, and human judgment matter.

  • Build at an early stage. Help shape the product, architecture, and engineering practices as Limetax scales across firms.

  • Meaningful upside. Competitive cash compensation plus meaningful equity.

Responsibilities

title: Private Practice Enablement Specialist (PST)
description:
Our Mission

Healthie is an AI-Native, ONC Certified EHR for modern outpatient healthcare.Â 

Healthie is proud to power clinically excellent healthcare for over 40,000 providers who deliver clinically excellent healthcare - longitudinal and collaboratively, with patient and provider experiences at the center. Both healthcare and technology are undergoing unparalleled industry innovation, and itâs incredible to see the momentum - from consumers, from providers, and from reimbursement for this type of healthcare - grow exponentially.Â 

We provide the powerful infrastructure every care delivery organization needs. On the surface this includes EHR, Scheduling, Engagement, Billing, Data, and much more. Underneath the iceberg are thousands of configurations, settings, widgets, automations, and limitless capabilities because we are an API-first platform. Our fully brandable platform makes it easy for clinics and organizations of any size to scale and never reach a limit.Â 

Today, over 3 billion API calls are made to Healthie every month, as thousands of organizations who work with more than 21 million patients in total, rely on Healthie to deliver clinically excellent healthcare in over 35 specialties, from behavioral healthcare to complex chronic care management and personalized medicine.

We believe in the power of technology to improve access to healthcare and weâre building the rails that make this a reality. We work fast and with quality because we provide business-critical, healthcare-critical software that clinicians and patients need for a better healthcare system. Weâre customer-obsessed, operate with lightning-fast processes and responses, and always share our product roadmap publicly-Â  so customers can see what weâre building, and remain relentlessly focused on how care gets delivered.

Healthie is backed by leading investors, and while we've $42M raised to date, more importantly, we operate with fiscal responsibility and have been profitable for more than half of our time as a company. We know that building an ONC-Certified EHR is a lifetimeâs body of work, and we are here to build for our customers forever.

Learn more at https://www.gethealthie.com/

About the role

Weâre hiring a Customer Success Manager to join our Private Practice Enablement team and help customers get the most out of Healthie throughout their entire journey with us. Youâll work with private practices and growing healthcare organizationsâsome brand new to Healthie, others who have been with us for years.

This is a highly customer-facing role centered around understanding how practices operate and helping them use Healthie to accomplish their goals. Youâll build relationships with healthcare executives, practice managers, providers, and clinical champions, becoming a trusted resource as their workflows, teams, and needs evolve.

Our ideal hire is curious, resourceful, and a natural educator. You enjoy learning how different healthcare organizations work, can turn complex questions into clear next steps, and are excited to develop the product expertise needed to help customers use Healthie successfully.

About the work

  • Youâll spend much of your day connecting directly with customers through live 1:1 calls and email, helping with everything from initial setup and training to workflow optimization, feature adoption, and new needs that emerge as their practices grow.
  • Youâll learn how customers deliver care, understand their operational and patient care goals, and use deep product knowledge to recommend workflows that make Healthie work for their organization.
  • Youâll solve problems in real time. Sometimes thereâs a straightforward answer; other times youâll need to investigate, think creatively, test different approaches, or bring in the right people to find a solution.
  • Youâll create personalized resources, screen recordings, and examples when showing a customer how to accomplish something is more helpful than simply telling them.
  • Youâll manage multiple customer conversations and priorities at once, adapting your communication and approach to different practices, personalities, and challenges.
  • Youâll collaborate with Support, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing, sharing what youâre learning from customers and helping improve our product, resources, processes, and overall customer experience.


Details, details

  • This is a full-time, remote position and U.S. work authorization is required.
  • This job is Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm PST.Â 
  • Weâre seeking fluent English speakers/writers.
  • The salary range is $93,000 - $102,500

About you

Youâve done this kind of work before. Weâre looking for someone with 3â5 years of experience in Customer Success or similar customer-facing role. And it is a requirement that you've worked at a software company. Bonus points if youâve worked in healthcare technology, or have experience working with private practices or growing healthcare organizations.

  • Youâre comfortable independently leading customer conversations and building relationships with everyone from individual providers to practice managers and healthcare leaders. You ask thoughtful questions, listen closely, and know how to adapt your approach to the person in front of you.
  • Youâre a natural educator and an excellent communicator. You can take complicated products, workflows, and questions and turn them into clear, practical next steps. We value good writers.
  • Youâre curious about how customers work. You want to understand what someone is actually trying to accomplish before recommending a solution, and you enjoy learning the different ways healthcare organizations operate and deliver care.
  • Youâre a strong problem-solver with good judgment. When there isnât an obvious answer, youâre comfortable researching, testing different approaches, and using the resources around you to figure out the best path forward.
  • Youâre organized and self-directed. You can manage customer calls, emails, follow-ups, and projects simultaneously, take ownership of whatâs in front of you, and recognize when something needs another perspective or team.
  • Youâre good at navigating challenging conversations. You can set expectations, explain limitations, and provide thoughtful guidance even when the answer isnât exactly what a customer hoped to hear.
  • You have plenty of tech skills, and you're confident working across a variety of tools and apps, and can troubleshoot everyday issues on your ownâthings like browser quirks, connectivity problems, login hiccups, and mobile device settings.
  • Youâre a collaborative teammate and strong customer advocate. You share what youâre learning, give helpful and direct feedback, and bring patterns from customer conversations back to the broader team so we can continue improving how we support our customers and build Healthie.

How to applyÂ 

Please submit a PDF cover letter and introduce yourself. Include:

  • Tell us who you are and why you want this job at Healthie.
  • Where are you based and what time zone are you in?
  • Why do you want to work in Customer Success?

In your cover letter, answer these real-world customer scenarios. Reply to the customer directly like you would if you worked on our Private Practice team. Also tell us how youâd approach the conversation, and explain your thinking for each reply.Â 

  • A customer recently signed up for Healthie and is excited to get started. They want to go live as soon as possible and have an upcoming appointment with a client. They need help manually adding the client to Healthie and sending them an invitation to access the platform.

  • A customer who has been using Healthie for several years reaches out because their practice has grown and their current workflow is no longer working well for their team. They have a specific idea for how theyâd like to solve the problem, but you arenât sure whether Healthie can support exactly what theyâre asking for.Â 

Interview Process

  • Quick chat with our Talent team (15 minutes)
  • Interview with Talita, Private Practice Team Lead (30 minutes)
  • Interview with Justin, VP of Customer Support (30 minutes)
  • Live demo with Talita and Jen (30 minutes)
    • Youâll be asked to give us a brief product demo. Youâll share your screen and show us how to add a client and schedule an appointment.Â 
  • Final session with Talita and Justin (30 minutes)
  • Reference checks

Healthie is subject to HIPAA and other security and privacy frameworks, and this job entails training and conformance to expectations regarding security and compliance.

Healthie participates in e-verify.

Healthie is committed to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to and will not be discriminated against based on age, race, gender, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability or any other protected category. We're proud to be building a diverse and inclusive environment that encourages collaboration, creativity, and growth. Whatever your background, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.Â

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Hallo, wir sind AMBOSS und suchen engagierte Supporthelden zur Unterstützung unserer Teams.

Als Customer Support Specialist bist du die wichtige Verbindung zwischen AMBOSS und seinen Nutzer:innen und hilfst dabei, die medizinische Versorgung für Millionen von Menschen zu verbessern. Unsere Mission ist es, Ärzt:innen und Studierenden auf der ganzen Welt zu ermöglichen, AMBOSS optimal zu nutzen und ihre Erfahrungen mit unserer Plattform entsprechend ihren Bedürfnissen zu verbessern.

Warum Customer Support bei AMBOSS?

Unsere Mission bei AMBOSS ist: Empower all medical professionals to provide the best possible care!
Als Customer Support Specialist bist du absolute:r Produktexpert:in und unterstützt so diese Mission.

Du wirst Teil eines Teams, dass sich aus einer bunten Mischung offener und freundlicher Persönlichkeiten und detailorientierter Problemlöser:innen zusammensetzt, die genauso schnell zusammen lachen wie sich gegenseitig unterstützen.
Jedes Teammitglied bringt Einiges an positiver Energie und eine echte Begeisterung für die Unterstützung sowie Interaktion mit unseren Nutzer:innen mit.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Unser Nutzer:innen unterstützen, indem du ihre Anfragen über verschiedene Kanäle (E-Mail, Telefon, Live-Chat, WhatsApp und Social Media) beantwortest

  • Unsere Nutzer:innen dazu beraten, wie sie AMBOSS bestmöglich nutzen können

  • Dich über Produktänderungen auf dem Laufenden halten und dich schnell in die Produktfeatures einarbeiten, um aktuelle Informationen weitergeben zu können

  • Mit dem Team zusammenarbeiten, um unser Produkt, die Customer Experience und interne Prozesse zu verbessern

  • Kundenfeedback erfassen und interne Datenbanken aktualisieren, um Trends zu erkennen und diese Informationen an unser Team weiterzugeben

  • Prozessverbesserungen, Wachstums- und Marketingprojekte unterstützen

Deine Fähigkeiten

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse, da Englisch unsere Unternehmenssprache ist.

  • Sehr starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Wort und Schrift. Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte präzise herunterbrechen und zielgruppengerecht vermitteln.

  • Hervorragende Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung

  • Geduld bei komplexen oder sensiblen Fällen

  • Vertrautheit mit verschiedenen Arten von Software und digitalen Tools

  • Erfahrung im Customer Support und/oder Gesundheitswesen sind ein großes Plus

  • Tolle Persönlichkeit, mit der man gerne zusammenarbeitet :)

Benefits:

AMBOSSSians erzählen uns, dass eine innovative Arbeit ihnen Antrieb gibt und sie sich durch Mitarbeiter-Benefits wertgeschätzt und in ihrer Arbeit bestärkt fühlen. Wir investieren in jeden AMBOSSian mit unseren Mitarbeiter-Benefits, die extra zugeschnitten wurden, um die finanzielle, physische und mentale Gesundheit zu unterstützen und zu einer positiven Work-Life-Balance beizutragen.

🌴 Erholung & Freizeit (30 bezahlte Urlaubstage, einen AMBOSS-Feiertag, ein persönlicher Purpose Day und mehr)

🥙 Verpflegung & Komfort (Täglich gesundes Frühstück und Mittagessen von unseren hauseigenen Küchenchefs im Berliner Büro, die AMBOSS-Kita, sowie die Möglichkeit, remote aus unseren Büros in Köln, Sardinien oder Kapstadt zu arbeiten)

🏃 Gesundheit & Mobilität (Urban Sports Club - M-Plan, Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland-Ticket und mehr)

 

Erfahre hier mehr über unsere Benefit-Pakete:

http://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt ein starker Motor für Innovation und Fortschritt ist. Deshalb engagieren wir uns für ein inklusives, respektvolles und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, ethnischer oder kultureller Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, sexueller Orientierung oder geschlechtlicher Identität – wertgeschätzt werden und die gleichen Chancen erhalten, ihr Potenzial zu entfalten.

Wir heißen Menschen mit den unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen herzlich willkommen, uns bei unserer Mission zu unterstützen: medizinisches Fachpersonal dabei zu stärken und die bestmögliche Versorgung zu gewährleisten.

title: Enterprise Account Executive (DACH) (Remote)
description:
Who We Are

Having surpassed $300M ARR and continuing to grow, Optro helps enterprises transform risk into opportunity through its AI-powered GRC Intelligence Platform. More than 50% of the Fortune 500, including 7 of the Fortune 10, leverage our award-winning technology to move their businesses forward with greater clarity and agility. And our customers love us: Optro is top-rated on G2.com and Gartner Peer Insights.

At Optro, we inspire each other to innovate and are proud of what we are producing. We spend each day thinking of new ways to help our customers and contribute to the greater good of our company and our surrounding communities. We are all about assisting each other and breaking through barriers to create the most loved audit, risk, ESG, and InfoSec platform by our customers. This is how we have become one of the 500 fastest-growing tech companies in North America for the seventh year in a row, as ranked by Deloitte!

Why This Role is Exciting

At Optro, we empower businesses with award-winning technology that transforms risk into strategic advantage. As we continue our expansion in the DACH region, we are looking for an experienced Enterprise Account Executive to drive meaningful business outcomes with our innovative solutions.

If you are a relationship-driven sales professional with a consultative mindset and a passion for delivering value to enterprise customers, this is your opportunity to shape the future of risk and compliance in one of Europe’s most advanced economies.

Opportunities in This Role

  • Work alongside a mission-driven team that values integrity, excellence, and shared success.

  • Thrive in a collaborative culture that celebrates high performance and continuous improvement.

  • Enjoy flexibility with remote-based working.

  • Be part of a high-growth company recognized as a Great Place to Work, where your impact is visible and rewarded.

  • Access competitive compensation, professional development, and career advancement opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts—including both publicly listed and privately held companies—across the DACH region.

  • Drive new logo acquisition, contributing directly to our growth in a key European market.

  • Operate from your home office in Germany, with travel to clients as needed or our London-based Optro office.

  • Report directly to the Director, Sales, and work cross-functionally with regional and global teams.

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with C-level stakeholders by understanding their challenges and mapping them to Optro’s platform capabilities.

  • Collaborate across Pre-Sales, Business Value Consulting, and Marketing, leveraging tools, partners, and events to drive pipeline and deal progression.

  • Partner with strategic alliances to deliver integrated, customer-centric outcomes.

Attributes for a Successful Candidate 

  • 5–7 years of experience in enterprise technology sales, ideally in SaaS or GRC software solutions.

  • Demonstrated experience in value-based selling and establishing long-term client partnerships.

  • Comfortable leveraging structured sales frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, Challenger Sale).

  • A learning-oriented mindset and a desire to grow within a fast-paced, international environment.

  • Familiarity with German regulatory environments and enterprise procurement expectations.

  • Competitive compensation & bonus program

  • Annual Leave: 30 days

  • Employee resource groups

  • Opportunities for team and company-wide get-togethers!

title: Finance Operations Intern (m/f/d)
description:
Über Buena

Buena digitalisiert die Hausverwaltung in Deutschland. Wir übernehmen traditionelle Hausverwaltungen und transformieren sie in moderne, technologiegetriebene Unternehmen – mit dem Ziel, Immobilienverwaltung einfach und transparent zu machen.

Deine Rolle

In deiner Rolle als Praktikant im Bereich Finance Operations bildest du das verlässliche Rückgrat unseres Finanzteams. Du steuerst die kompletten Abläufe der Kreditorenbuchhaltung, begleitest aktiv die Einführung frischer Systeme sowie Abläufe und agierst als maßgebliche Schnittstelle zu externen Steuerberatern. Gleichzeitig garantierst du reibungslose, strukturierte Prozesse in unseren Tochterunternehmen. An der Seite von Finance Lead und CFO erhältst du umfassende Einblicke in sämtliche Finanzstrukturen, vom einzelnen Beleg bis zur strategischen Liquiditätssteuerung.

Was du tun wirst

  • Accounts Payable: Du managst unseren Eingangsrechnungs-Workflow von A bis Z – Postkorb, Invoice Chasing, Freigabeprozesse und Zahlungen ausführen. Sorgfalt und ein Auge für Details sind hier entscheidend.

  • Buchungsqualität: Du stellst sicher, dass Rechnungen mit den richtigen Konten, Kostenstellen und Steuersätzen erfasst werden. Du bist die erste Instanz, bevor Buchungen zu unseren Steuerberatern gehen, und unterstützt bei buchhalterischen Rückfragen.

  • Tochtergesellschaften: Du überprüfst regelmäßig die BWAs unserer Töchter, erkennst Abweichungen und Unplausibilitäten und stellst sicher, dass vorgegebene Prozesse konsequent eingehalten werden.

  • Liquiditätssteuerung & Systemimplementierung: Du erlernst die Arbeit mit Agicap – unserem zentralen Werkzeug für Eingangs- und Ausgangsrechnungen, Zahlungsabläufe sowie das Liquiditätsmanagement. Zudem begleitest du den Rollout in unseren Tochtergesellschaften, schulst die Teams vor Ort und gewährleistest eine hohe Datenqualität und Vollständigkeit.

  • Ad-hoc & Ops-Schnittstelle: Du packst auch mal an, wenn es brennt. Sei es bei Finance-nahen Sonderprojekten oder gelegentlicher Unterstützung im Ops-Bereich.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn

  • Du Ownership liebst und nicht wartest, bis jemand anderes eine Rechnung sucht, einen Fehler korrigiert oder einen Prozess aufräumt – du siehst es, du löst es.

  • Du Buchungen nicht als lästiges Pflichtprogramm siehst, sondern verstehst, warum die Kontenwahl relevant ist – für das Reporting, für die Steuer, für das große Ganze.

  • Du dich in einem Tool schnell zurechtfindest, das du vorher noch nie gesehen hast. Agicap, Moss, Lucanet, Datev – wenn du eines davon kennst, lernst du die anderen schnell.

  • Du in Unklarheit handlungsfähig bleibst. In einem Startup sind Prozesse oft im Aufbau. Du baust mit, anstatt auf fertige Strukturen zu warten.

  • Du Qualität mit Pragmatismus verbindest. Du machst es richtig – aber du weißt auch, wann „gut genug“ besser ist als „perfekt in drei Wochen“.

  • Du fließend Deutsch und Englisch sprichst. Die Kommunikation mit unseren Steuerberatern und Tochtergesellschaften erfolgt auf Deutsch, während wir intern auf Englisch kommunizieren. Hard requirement.

  • Du aus unserem Office in Prenzlauer Berg arbeiten willst. Das ist keine Remote-Rolle. Hard requirement.

Was du bekommst

  • Bis zu €500 Office-Nähe-Bonus, wenn du innerhalb von 10–20 Gehminuten zum Office wohnst (oder hinziehst).

  • €110/Monat Mittagessen-Budget, €50 monatlicher Fitness-Zuschuss.

  • €1.200 jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget.

  • Kostenlose Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.

title: Webdesigner-/Entwickler – WordPress & AI (m/w/d)
description:
Web Developer – WordPress & AI (m/w/d)

Du denkst digital, liebst Technologie und findest, dass KI erst der Anfang ist? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Wir sind ANY Marketing – eine junge, dynamische Digitalagentur und Teil der The Radio Group. Während andere Radio machen, machen wir Radio und denken digital weiter.

Wir entwickeln moderne Websites, individuelle Softwarelösungen, eigene Tools und KI-gestützte Anwendungen. Dabei verbinden wir Kreativität, Technologie und künstliche Intelligenz mit der Reichweite und den Möglichkeiten eines Medienunternehmens.

Unser Alltag? Alles außer Standard. Heute eine Website für den Bäcker um die Ecke, morgen ein digitales Projekt für einen Großkonzern und übermorgen vielleicht eine eigene Softwarelösung, die es so noch gar nicht gibt.

Dafür suchen wir dich!

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Du konzipierst und entwickelst moderne, individuelle Websites auf Basis von WordPress und Breakdance.

  • Du entwickelst eigene WordPress-Plugins, Schnittstellen und individuelle Funktionalitäten.

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools aktiv in deinem Entwicklungsalltag und entdeckst neue Möglichkeiten, Prozesse intelligenter und effizienter zu gestalten.

  • Du begleitest digitale Kundenprojekte von der ersten Idee bis zum Go-live.

  • Du arbeitest an unseren eigenen digitalen Produkten, Plattformen und innovativen Anwendungen mit.

  • Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kunden, verstehst ihre Anforderungen und entwickelst passende Lösungen.

  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und probierst neue Technologien aus.

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung mit WordPress – und zwar über die reine Inhaltspflege hinaus.

  • HTML, CSS, JavaScript und PHP sind für dich keine Fremdwörter.

  • Du hast erste Erfahrungen mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung gesammelt, beispielsweise mit Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT oder vergleichbaren Tools.

  • Du hast ein Gespür für moderne Websites, gutes Design, Performance und Benutzerfreundlichkeit.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, lösungsorientiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung.

  • Du bist kommunikativ und hast keine Scheu vor dem direkten Kundenkontakt.

  • Du bist neugierig auf neue Technologien und hast Lust, dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Nice to have, aber kein Muss:

  • Erfahrung mit Breakdance oder vergleichbaren modernen WordPress-Buildern

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung eigener WordPress-Plugins

  • Kenntnisse in Next.js, React oder anderen modernen Webtechnologien

  • Erfahrung mit APIs, Automatisierungen und KI-Agenten

  • Kenntnisse in Git, Hosting und Deployment

Du musst nicht alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du Lust hast, Neues zu lernen, Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und gemeinsam mit uns etwas aufzubauen.

Was wir dir bieten

  • KI-first statt KI irgendwann: Bei uns ist künstliche Intelligenz kein Zukunftsthema, sondern gelebter Arbeitsalltag.

  • Abwechslung garantiert: Spannende Projekte vom lokalen Handwerksbetrieb bis zum Großkonzern.

  • Homeoffice: Flexibles Arbeiten, das zu deinem Alltag passt.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Weniger Bürokratie, mehr Umsetzung.

  • Echte Kundennähe: Du erlebst unmittelbar, welchen Unterschied deine Arbeit macht.

  • Raum für deine Ideen: Wir wollen nicht nur, dass du Aufgaben abarbeitest, sondern dass du mitgestaltest.

  • Moderne Technologien: Die Möglichkeit, neue Tools, Frameworks und KI-Anwendungen auszuprobieren und produktiv einzusetzen.

  • Ein außergewöhnliches Arbeitsumfeld: Als Teil der The Radio Group arbeitest du mitten in der Medienwelt – zwischen Radiostudios, kreativen Köpfen, digitalen Innovationen und spannenden Persönlichkeiten.

  • Ein Team auf Augenhöhe: Offener Austausch, gemeinsames Lernen und Spaß an dem, was wir tun.

  • Perspektive: Gestalte mit uns den wachsenden digitalen Geschäftsbereich einer Mediengruppe aktiv mit.

Dein Lebenslauf ist nicht dein Code.

Ob du studiert hast, eine Ausbildung abgeschlossen hast oder dir das Entwickeln selbst beigebracht hast, ist für uns zweitrangig. Entscheidend ist, was du kannst, wie du denkst und wohin du dich entwickeln möchtest.

Zeig uns gerne, woran du bereits gearbeitet hast, welche Projekte dich begeistern oder wie du KI in deinem Alltag einsetzt.

Wir wollen Menschen kennenlernen, keine perfekten Bewerbungsunterlagen.

Let's build something great.

Du hast Lust, gemeinsam mit uns die digitale Zukunft eines Medienunternehmens zu gestalten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

ANY Marketing GmbH
Ein Unternehmen der The Radio Group

www.any-marketing.de

title: Werkstudent / Praktikant (m/w/d) – Growth Marketing & Content
description:
Über STRIVE

STRIVE Nutrition ist eine wachsende Premium-Marke für pflanzliche Bio-Proteine und hochwertige Supplements.

Unser Anspruch ist es, Produkte zu entwickeln, die in Qualität, Rezeptur und Design neue Maßstäbe setzen: hochwertige Bio-Rohstoffe, konsequent durchdachte Rezepturen, transparente Kommunikation und ein moderner Markenauftritt.

Heute verkaufen wir unsere Produkte insbesondere über Amazon und unseren eigenen Onlineshop. Gleichzeitig stehen wir vor unserer bisher größten Wachstumsphase: Wir erweitern unser Produktsortiment deutlich, entwickeln Markenauftritt und Produktdesign weiter, bauen unsere Direct-to-Consumer-Aktivitäten aus und bereiten die internationale Expansion vor.

Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der nicht nur „Social Media betreut“, sondern gemeinsam mit uns daran arbeitet, eine starke Consumer Brand aufzubauen.

Deine Rolle

Als Werkstudent oder Praktikant im Bereich Growth Marketing & Content arbeitest du direkt mit den Gründern an unserem Markenauftritt und unseren wichtigsten Marketingkanälen.

Du bekommst früh Verantwortung und arbeitest sowohl kreativ als auch analytisch: von Content und Influencer-Kooperationen über CRM bis zur Entwicklung neuer Kampagnen.

Dabei geht es ausdrücklich nicht darum, ausschließlich vorgegebene Aufgaben abzuarbeiten. Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, eigene Ideen entwickelt und Projekte selbstständig vorantreibt.

Bei Dauer des Praktikums / der Werkstudententätigkeit und der wöchentlichen Stundenzahl sind wir flexibel.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Content & Social Media: Konzeption und Umsetzung von Content für Instagram, TikTok und weitere relevante Plattformen

  • Content Production: Entwicklung von Ideen und Briefings für Fotos, Videos, Reels, UGC und Performance Creatives

  • Influencer & Creator Marketing: Recherche, Ansprache und Betreuung passender Influencer, Creator und Markenbotschafter

  • Kampagnen: Unterstützung bei der Konzeption, Umsetzung und Auswertung von Produktlaunches und Marketingkampagnen

  • CRM & Customer Marketing: Mitarbeit an Newslettern, automatisierten E-Mail-Flows, Kundenbefragungen und Maßnahmen zur Kundenbindung

  • Brand Building: Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Markenkommunikation, Produktpositionierung und visuellen Markenwelt

  • Growth: Identifikation neuer Marketingkanäle, Kooperationen, Formate und Wachstumshebel

  • Analytics: Analyse relevanter KPIs und Ableitung konkreter Optimierungsmaßnahmen

  • Trend Scouting: Beobachtung von Social-Media-, Fitness-, Health- und Consumer-Trends sowie Identifikation relevanter Best Practices

  • Launches: Enge Begleitung neuer Produkte von der Positionierung bis zur Markteinführung

Was du mitbringen solltest

Uns ist weniger wichtig, dass dein Lebenslauf perfekt ist. Entscheidend ist, dass du schnell lernst, Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und ein gutes Gefühl für Marken und Kommunikation hast.

Idealerweise:

  • studierst du Marketing, Medien, Kommunikation, BWL, E-Commerce oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang mit überdurchschnittlich guten Noten

  • hast du ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Marken, Social Media, E-Commerce und Consumer Products

  • bewegst du dich selbstverständlich auf Plattformen wie Instagram und TikTok und verstehst, welcher Content dort funktioniert

  • hast du ein sehr gutes Gespür für Ästhetik, Sprache und Markenkommunikation

  • kannst du idealerweise mit Tools wie Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud, CapCut oder vergleichbaren Programmen umgehen

  • arbeitest du strukturiert und kannst Projekte eigenständig vorantreiben

  • bist du analytisch genug, Entscheidungen nicht nur nach Bauchgefühl, sondern auch anhand von Daten zu treffen

  • verfügst du über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse

  • interessierst du dich für Ernährung, Fitness, Health oder hochwertige Consumer Brands

Vor allem suchen wir jemanden, der Eigeninitiative, Neugier und einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch mitbringt.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und ein breiter Einblick in alle Bereiche des E-Commerce

  • Verantwortung und eigene Projekte vom ersten Tag an, statt klassischer Praktikantenaufgaben

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen oder Verbesserungsvorschläge unmittelbar umzusetzen

  • Homeoffice, Flexible Arbeitszeiten und gute Vereinbarkeit mit deinem Studium.

  • Eine sehr steile Lernkurve in einem erfahrenen Team

  • Die Möglichkeit, bei guter Zusammenarbeit langfristig Verantwortung bei STRIVE zu übernehmen

  • Und natürlich: ausreichend STRIVE-Produkte für dich

So bewirbst du dich

Bewirb dich einfach über den Button auf dieser Seite. Ein klassisches Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich.

Wir bringen regionales Handwerk und skalierbare Software zusammen: Solar, Speicher, Wärmepumpe und E-Mobilität denken wir nicht einzeln, sondern steuern sie als intelligentes, integriertes Gesamtsystem in unserem virtuellen Kraftwerk. Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen

Benefits

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen
  • Nutze das MacBook auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit

title: Growth
description:
About Kyra

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

💼 The role

You’ll own our events from the first idea to the meetings that come out of them. One month that’s a 15-person dinner in Shoreditch, the next it’s a week at Cannes Lions. 🎬 Either way you write the brief, book the venue, fill the room with the right people from our Top 200 and our partners, and make sure every guest turns up and hears from us afterwards.

The phone is how you make that work. 📞 You’ll call guest lists rather than cold lists, to get people into the room and to follow up once they’ve been. Alongside events you’ll look after our partners, run the partner newsletter and build your own voice on LinkedIn. We’ll measure you on two things: the sales-accepted leads (SALs) you create for our AEs, and the feedback on our events. 📈

🛠️ What you’ll do

Everything you do hangs off two groups of people: those coming to our events, and our partners. You won’t run cold outbound sequences; those sit with our AEs.

🎉 Events, from brief to follow-up

  • Take each opportunity we spot and make it live: write the brief, book the venue, build the Luma page and description, and start the invites

  • Build guest lists from the Top 200 and our partners for dinners, breakfasts and conference moments in London, New York and LA

  • Design and run the cadence from invite to the room, so that people arrive, they’re greeted and introduced to the right AE, and they’re followed up the next day

  • Collect feedback from guests, partners and AEs after every event, and use it to make the next one better

  • Travel a lot next year for events and conferences, including the US ✈️

📞 Calling and meetings

  • Call the guest list before every event: confirm registrants, turn maybes into yeses and chase no-shows

  • Call everyone who came within 48 hours, while the conversation is still warm

  • Book meetings for our AEs off the back of events and partner intros, with a clear handover: who they are, what they care about, how we met them

  • Keep HubSpot clean so every event and partner lead can be traced to a meeting

🤝 Partners and newsletter

  • Write and send the partner newsletter: what’s coming up, which brands we’re trying to meet and where partners can help

  • Own regular touch-bases with our Friends of Kyra partners: onboarding them, keeping them close to our events, and logging their intros and referrals

📣 Social and your own brand

  • Build your own presence on LinkedIn. We’re pushing hard on social across Kyra and you’ll be one of its voices

  • Turn every event into content: what got said in the room, not just who came

🔍 Who we’re looking for

✅ Must-haves

  • 2–4 years in events, partnerships, community or an SDR role, ideally dealing with senior people at brands

  • You love the phone, and would rather call than send a third email ☎️

  • You’ve run events people talked about afterwards, and you sweat the details: the seating plan, the intro, the follow-up

  • You post on LinkedIn already, or badly want to

  • You use Claude every day to research guests, write invites, plan events and build your own workflows 🤖

  • You’re up for a lot of travel next year, including the US

⭐ Nice-to-haves

  • A feel for the creator economy, social and the brands people talk about

  • Experience with HubSpot, Luma or beehiiv

  • Has built their own Claude skills or automations

🎁 What you get

  • 🥂 The rooms. You’ll sit at the table with CMOs and creator leaders most people at your level only get to email

  • 🌎 The travel. New York, LA and the conference circuit next year

  • 🔑 Ownership early. You’re the second hire on a new team, the events calendar is yours, and the role grows as the team does

  • 💡 Help building your own brand. We run LinkedIn workshops with creators and will work on your posts with you

  • 🚪 Access. You’ll work day to day with the Growth team, our AEs and our CEO

Benefits
🌎 Remote-first, so you can work from wherever you do your best work
🌴 25 days PTO + bank holidays, 3 wellness days and paid sick leave
📚 Annual Learning and Development budget
💰 Annual bonus scheme to recognise great work
🩺 Healthcare coverage for US-based team members

AI is core to how we operate. Use it to elevate your work. But everything in your application should reflect your own judgement and experience.

 

👀 Haven't found your role yet? Join People of Influence 🌟

📬 We share the best roles in influence every week, and our own jobs go there first 🚀

🔔 Get notified here 👈

💟 Support

If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. Please note that when you submit an application or resume, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy.

title: Infrastructure Site Reliability Engineer
description:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software .

As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace.

Job Summary:

We’re looking for an experienced Infrastructure Site Reliability Engineer to run and evolve our infrastructure stack. You’ll contribute across bare-metal, virtualization, and orchestration layers,

keeping things stable and secure 24/7 x 365 — all while mentoring teammates, improving process and automation as well as helping translate deep technical concepts for a wide range of collaborators and customers.

What You’ll Do :

  • Deploy and operate resilient, scalable infrastructure supporting AI/HPC workloads

  • Optimize Linux system configuration, BIOS/firmware, kernel, and disk subsystem for performance

  • Configure, monitor and manage bare-metal infrastructure using IPMI, Redfish, etc

  • Build and maintain automation scripts and infrastructure as code to support platform lifecycle, as well as simplifying troubleshooting for Incident resolution and provision of tooling for our support organisation

  • Apply ITSM frameworks: Incident, Major Incident, Change Management, and service improvement.

  • Maintain and enhance ’s observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, and custom monitoring integrations

  • Operate and support services in 24x7 production environments, including on-call rotation

  • Contribute to Incident postmortem analyses, root cause analysis, document learnings, and automate remediations

  • Mentor junior engineers and act as an Operational requirements consultant to other departments

  • Communicate technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders and customers

  • Uphold a culture of: do, document, automate

  • Willingness to cross train with Platform Engineering/Platform SRE to fully support both our infrastructure and platform stacks.

  • Willingness to cross train with HPC Engineering, supported by NVIDIA to enhance our

  • HPC supportability offering

What you bring:

  • 5+ Years Proven experience in globally scaled, performance-intensive environments operating to a 24/7 support model

  • Expert-level Linux administration, especially Ubuntu distributions

  • Proficiency in system tuning, disk I/O optimization, and hardware-level performance tweaks

  • Familiarity with Out of Band management tools (IPMI, Redfish, PXE, etc.)

  • Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching

  • Strong experience with infrastructure scripting and automation (Bash, Python, Ansible)

  • Deep understanding of observability principles and tools (Prometheus, Grafana)

  • Hands-on experience operating orchestration platforms (Kubernetes, MAAS, Tinkerbell)

  • Strong grasp of ITSM and service operation best practices

  • Excellent communication and mentorship skills

  • Comfortable interfacing with internal stakeholders and external customers

  • Bonus: Knowledge of HPC workloads and GPU-based infrastructure

  • Bonus: Experience with InfiniBand networks and HPC performance tuning

Nice to have:

  • Bachelor or Masters Level degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field, or equivalent experience.

  • LPIC Certifications

  • ITIL Foundation level qualification or equivalent experience

How you work:

  • You approach problems with a systems mindset - balancing practical execution with long-term scalability

  • You elevate the team, setting high standards for technical quality and engineering excellence.

  • You hold yourself and others accountable - giving direct feedback and expecting the same

  • You take initiative, owning challenges end-to-end and proactively driving solutions.

  • You invest in others, mentoring to build both capability and confidence.

  • You communicate clearly - translating complexity into clarity across engineering and business audiences

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging

We are an equal opportunity employer and we strive to reduce unconscious bias throughout our hiring process. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity status or disability status. To ensure our recruitment processes provide an equal opportunity for all applicants to succeed, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments that we can make.
