title: Account Executive | HCLS | New Logo
description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you’ll do at Jamf

At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work. As an Account Executive focused on new logo growth in Healthcare & Life Sciences, you’ll open doors at organizations that don’t run Jamf today, build relationships with decision makers across IT, clinical, and research teams, and establish Jamf as a trusted partner in your territory. Your efforts will drive sales of our Whole Product Experience (WPE), build qualified pipeline from the ground up, and bring in new customers. You’ll work closely with Sales Development Representatives and Sales Engineers to take new business from first conversation to signed contract. As a member of the Jamf family, you’ll bring our high-energy, collaborative, and fun spirit to every deal.

This role if offered as remote in the Western & Midwest Territory. You may be required to work periodically at a Jamf office or collaborative work location with other Jamf employees in your area for certain events or moments that matter. We are only able to accept applications for those based in the Western & Midwest Territories and have sponsorship to live and work in the United States.

What you can expect to do in this role

  • Own the full sales cycle for net-new healthcare and life sciences accounts, from prospecting through close, presenting to multiple levels of each organization to demonstrate the value of Jamf’s full suite.
  • Build a targeted prospect list in your territory and create qualified pipeline through outbound research, referrals, and partner introductions.
  • Research each prospect’s environment, including Apple device fleets, compliance requirements, and clinical or research workflows, and partner with Sales Engineers to design solutions that fit.
  • Engage executives and key stakeholders early to position Jamf as a strategic option and turn first meetings into long-term customer relationships.
  • Build trusted relationships across the sales ecosystem, including Channel Partners and Apple, to open doors and co-sell into healthcare and life sciences organizations.
  • Forecast sales activity and revenue achievement monthly and quarterly, and share what you learn in the field to sharpen our approach to the vertical.
  • Leverage industry leading sales tech stack including SalesForce.com, Clari, Groove, ZoomInfo , LinkedIn Navigator, and much more

What we’re looking for

  • Minimum of 1 year experience in a sales role (Required)
  • Demonstrated ability to carry a quota and consistently meet or exceed targets (Preferred)
  • Proven experience prospecting and closing new logos, building pipeline without relying on an existing book of business (Preferred)
  • Minimum of 2 years health-tech, med-tech, biotech, or life sciences sales experience, including selling to health systems, hospitals, pharma, biotech, or research institutions (Preferred)
  • Minimum of 2 years software sales experience (Preferred)
  • Familiarity with the Apple ecosystem or SaaS sales is a plus, but not required.
  • #LIRemote

Education and certifications

  • HS Diploma / GED (Required)
  • 4 Year / Bachelor’s Degree (Preferred)
  • A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered

How we help you reach your best potential

  • Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
  • Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
  • Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families
  • Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
  • We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class, sales-focused Bootcamp gives you the technical and product knowledge to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.

Pay Transparency

At Jamf, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

For sales and commission-based roles, we post On-Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus estimated commission based on achieving 100% of performance targets. Commission is not guaranteed and varies based on individual performance results.

The national pay transparency range below represents all U.S. locations and accounts for geographic differences in pay, resulting in a broader range.

National Pay Transparency Range

$58,100—$133,200 USD

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

Jamf is committed to creating an inclusive & supportive work environment for all candidates and employees. Candidates with disabilities or religious beliefs are encouraged to reach out if they need additional support or alternative options to our recruiting processes to accommodate their disability or religious belief. If you need an accommodation, please contact your Recruiter or Recruiting Coordinator directly. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager. Jamf is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against individuals who request reasonable accommodation for disability or religious beliefs. To request accommodations please email us at recruiting@jamf.com

title: Account Executive - Banking vertical
description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

About Us:

Loan Vision is a PE backed (Banyan Software) high growth tech firm focused on providing loan-level accounting software designed to serve the mortgage banking industry. Since launching at the MBA Technology Solutions Conference and Expo in 2013, Loan Vision has helped reduce risk, streamline manual process, and lower operating expense for over 270 customers by combining a leading financial management solution with loan level accounting. Loan Vision strives to help transform accounting departments across the mortgage industry, aiding them in reaching maximum efficiency and offering tools to give them better insight into their profitability. We believe that every mortgage bank should have instant access to the financial information needed to make quick, strategic decisions and pride ourselves on providing, not only just the right tools, but also the right implementation approach and ongoing support to allow customers to maximize their use of our software. For more information, please visit: www.loan-vision.com. Our superior technology resides on the Microsoft Dynamics platform and is hosted in Microsoft Azure. This combination has allowed Loan Vision to grow to over 270 customers, including some of the top mortgage lenders in the nation and a growing base of banks.

In June of 2023, Loan Vision CEO/Founder Martin Kerr and Banyan Software appointed Paul J. Loftus to the CEO position to lead the next phase of hypergrowth. Having spent the majority of his career in technology and serving the accounting profession, Loftus was named to the 2014 40 Under 40 Honoree list by CPA Practice Advisor. His diverse experience spans 16 years at ADP directing go-to-market strategies, launching new tax and accounting cloud technology at Wolters Kluwer, and occupying the Chief Revenue Officer role at high-tech companies has uniquely positioned him to lead Loan Vision’s next phase of growth.

Position Summary

As an Account Executive focused on the Banking vertical, you will drive net-new business with regional and mid-sized banks and credit unions. Many of these institutions still manage loan-level accounting and profitability reporting in Excel and BI tools. This is a complex, consultative software sale: you will prospect and open doors yourself, build relationships with CFOs, Controllers, and other senior finance leaders, run discovery that uncovers their real accounting and reporting challenges, demo the product yourself, and guide each opportunity through a multi-stakeholder sales cycle to close.

Your impact will directly drive the growth of Loan Vision, giving you the opportunity to not only achieve substantial earnings through a competitive compensation package but also play a significant role in shaping the future of the mortgage finance industry.

Requirements

  • Asks sharp, thoughtful discovery questions and listens more than talks
  • Persistence to prospect and open doors without relying on a well-known brand name
  • Ability to turn relationships into qualified pipeline and closed business
  • Highly organized
  • Disciplined
  • “Figure it out” DNA
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to handle multiple sales opportunities
  • Confidence to try new things with vague or little direction
  • Confidence to fail and keep trying
  • Strong People skills
  • Attention to detail, resourcefulness, and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Good time management skills and ability to prioritize work
  • Ability to travel and work remotely
  • A good sense of humor
  • Positive attitude
  • Low ego

Responsibilities

  • Own a net-new sales pipeline focused on regional and mid-sized banks and credit unions
  • Prospect and generate your own leads to build pipeline and open new accounts
  • Work directly with CFOs, Controllers, and senior finance leaders at banks and credit unions
  • Run discovery and deliver product demonstrations yourself; deep product knowledge is expected
  • Manage long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first meeting through close
  • Expand relationships with existing bank and credit union customers
  • Leverage your network to build relationships and convert them into qualified pipeline
  • Partner with marketing on campaigns and industry webinars tailored to Bank and Credit Union audiences
  • Own CRM hygiene and accurate pipeline forecasting using Salesforce
  • Coordinate with internal teams on pricing, proposals, and handoff to implementation
  • Travel to conferences and client sites as needed (10–25%)

Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Standard Holidays
  • Competitive health benefits
  • 401k Program
  • Collaborative work atmosphere

title: Clinical Talent Recruiter
description:
Brightside Health delivers life-saving virtual mental healthcare to everyone who needs it. We are powered by proprietary AI, purpose-built technology, a world-class clinician network, and a care model that rivals the best of in-person treatment. When combined with precision psychiatry and leading-edge therapeutic techniques, we’re able to improve outcomes for those with mild-to-severe clinical depression, anxiety, and other mood disorders.

We take an action-oriented, purposeful approach with everything we do and seek out team members who value collaboration and thoughtful prioritization. As a result, our organization is looking for the brightest and most innovative talent in the industry. We can promise you that, as a member of the Brightside team, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate alongside smart and driven people while growing your professional skills.

Our prescribing network is at the center of our next phase of growth, and we’re hiring a Clinical Talent Recruiter to help continue the mission. You’ll work alongside the Talent Team recruiting for Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioners (PMHNPs) and Psychiatrists, interviewing candidates daily, building a deep bench of qualified applicants, and prioritizing multi-state licensed talent who can expand our coverage and help us serve more patients.

This is a high-impact seat for someone who knows the mental healthcare recruiting market inside and out: how prescribers think about telehealth, what drives them, and what it takes to get a prescriber from first conversation through onboarding and seeing patients.

What you’ll be doing as Clinical Talent Recruiter:

  • Report directly to Brightside’s Sr. Director of Talent Operations, and work closely with the Network Operations team to coordinate recruitment strategy.
  • Drive full-cycle recruiting for PMHNPs, from sourcing through interviewing, offer acceptance, and onboarding, in support of Rx network growth targets.
  • Conduct video interviews daily, assessing clinical background, prescribing experience, and telehealth readiness.
  • Build and maintain a bench of qualified, interview-ready candidates so we can move quickly as state and capacity needs shift.
  • Prioritize and source multi-state licensed PMHNPs, partnering with Network Operations to target the states where we need coverage.
  • Actively source through LinkedIn, job boards, professional associations, NP communities, and referrals.
  • Partner with the Talent Team and leadership to define and refine screening criteria, including licensure, board certification, DEA registration, prescribing experience, and patient population experience.
  • Manage candidates in our ATS (Fountain), keeping detailed interview notes and moving candidates through the funnel with urgency.
  • Contribute to team-wide talent projects beyond day-to-day recruiting, such as new hiring initiatives, process improvements, and special sourcing pushes, as business priorities evolve.
  • Foster long-term relationships with past applicants and potential candidates.

Requirements:

  • 2+ years of clinical talent acquisition or healthcare recruiting experience in high-growth environments, with hands-on experience hiring mental health prescribers (PMHNP or nurse practitioner experience strongly preferred)
  • Working knowledge of the PMHNP landscape, including state scope-of-practice differences (full practice authority vs. collaborative or supervisory requirements), multi-state licensure, board certification, and controlled-substance prescribing considerations is all a plus.
  • Experience sourcing candidates in highly competitive environments
  • Hands-on experience with high-volume and full-cycle recruiting using various interview techniques and evaluation methods
  • Knowledge of Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) (Fountain is a plus)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • A bias for action, strong prioritization skills, and comfort working in a fast-moving environment.

Benefits:

  • A competitive salary
  • Stock options so you have equity
  • Fully paid for comprehensive health care (medical, dental, vision)
  • Pet Insurance
  • Life Insurance & Short / Long Term Disability
  • 401k Plan
  • Unlimited PTO and sick leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Work remotely
  • Additional memberships and perks

Work Environment & Culture

At Brightside Health, you’ll join a fully remote, mission-driven team that values flexibility and impact. You’ll collaborate with professionals across engineering, product, and clinical teams, all dedicated to transforming mental healthcare. Our culture fosters continuous learning, empathy, and cross-functional collaboration.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to equal employment opportunities based on merit, competence, and performance. Research shows that underrepresented groups often apply only if they meet 100% of the listed criteria—we encourage women, people of color, and LGBTQ+ job seekers to apply even if they don’t check every box.

Compensation & Hiring Commitment

Final offers are determined by multiple factors, including location, experience, and expertise. If you have questions about compensation bands, please ask your recruiter.

At Brightside, we recognize that building life-changing technology for mental health is both a responsibility and a privilege. We set high standards while ensuring every team member is valued, trusted, and empowered in an environment driven by inclusion and impact.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Your focus is Kinsta's paid social presence across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms. You'll reach the businesses, agencies, and enterprises that run their sites on WordPress, through campaigns that cover the full funnel from awareness to customer acquisition.

You'll own campaigns from build to optimization, keep conversion tracking reliable, and turn performance data into clear recommendations. The ideal Kinsta Paid Media Specialist is analytical, detail-oriented, curious, proactive, and collaborative.

What You Will Do:

Plan, build, launch, and manage paid social campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms, covering the full funnel from awareness and demand generation to lead generation and customer acquisition.

Monitor performance and continuously optimize targeting, bidding strategies, budgets, ad creatives, and landing pages, scaling what works while keeping acquisition costs efficient.

Analyze campaign performance using ad platform data, web analytics, and CRM reporting, and build reports and dashboards that share results and actionable insights.

Collaborate with content, design, product marketing, and sales on ad copy, creative concepts, and campaign assets that match our messaging and business priorities.

Use AI tools to streamline research, reporting, ad copy, and creative ideation, automate repetitive tasks, and apply critical thinking to AI-generated recommendations so decisions stay grounded in accurate data and business objectives.

What You Bring To The Role:

2-4 years of hands-on experience independently building, launching, managing, and optimizing paid social campaigns, including on Meta, LinkedIn, and Reddit, ideally in hosting, B2B technology, or a related industry.

Practical experience setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking with Google Tag Manager, GA4, and advertising platform pixels or conversion tags.

A strong understanding of core paid media metrics, including CPC, CPM, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS, and experience analyzing campaign data and turning findings into actionable optimizations.

Familiarity with audience targeting, retargeting, and campaign testing methodologies, and an understanding of marketing funnels, attribution, and how paid media contributes to lead generation and customer acquisition.

Attention to detail, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities at once.

Bonus if you have:

Experience running paid media campaigns for B2B SaaS, hosting, PaaS, or other technical products, and familiarity with WordPress or cloud platforms.

Experience with CRM, marketing automation, and attribution or reporting tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Looker Studio, Dreamdata, or HockeyStack.

Knowledge of advanced conversion tracking, including enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports, and server-side tracking, plus a basic understanding of HTML, JavaScript, cookies, and how tracking tags work on websites.

Experience optimizing landing pages and collaborating on conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.

Proficiency in other languages and experience managing non-English paid media campaigns

Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve campaign workflows, analysis, and creative development.

Annual remote expense budget.

Flexible PTO.

Paid parental leave.

Annual professional development budget: available after one year with Kinsta.

Sabbatical: available after three years with Kinsta (and every three years thereafter).

Location-specific healthcare benefits (includes vision and dental) for employees hired in the USA, UK, Canada, and Hungary.

Pension plan for employees hired in the UK, and 401k contributions for employees hired in the USA.

title: Praktikant (m/w/d) RPA-Automatisierung im Marketing | Vollzeit | Remote oder Hybrid
description:
DIU ist IT-Dienstleister für MarTech-Lösungen (Marketing Technology: Technologien, mit denen Marketing- und Content-Prozesse geplant, automatisiert und ausgespielt werden) sowie AI & Cloud Services mit einer über 25-jährigen Tradition. An unseren zwei Standorten in Hamburg und Wiesbaden entwickeln, integrieren und betreiben wir IT-Lösungen für Unternehmen aus Handel, Versicherung, Medien und Industrie.

Zu unseren langjährigen Kunden zählen unter anderem OTTO, R+V Versicherung, Allianz Trade und Suzuki.

DIU ist geprägt von einer Kultur der Innovation und vom Anspruch, Technologie dort einzusetzen, wo sie messbar Wirkung erzeugt. Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der IT getreu unserem Motto: Unleash your power in IT.

Mehr zu uns: www.diu.digital

Aufgaben

WANTED

Unser Geschäftsbereich MarTech unterstützt große Unternehmen dabei, Marketing- und Content-Prozesse mit Technologie effizienter zu gestalten – von der Marketing Production Automation (kurz: MPA) bis hin zur Prozessautomatisierung mit RPA (Robotic Process Automation). RPA bedeutet: Software-Roboter übernehmen manuelle, repetitive Aufgaben in digitalen Systemen – zum Beispiel das automatische Anlegen, Bearbeiten oder Löschen von Einträgen in einem CMS oder die automatisierte Ausspielung von Beiträgen im Intranet. Für einen unserer Konzernkunden bauen wir genau das aktuell auf: RPA-Lösungen für Marketing und Unternehmenskommunikation, weil die eingesetzten Systeme keine klassischen Schnittstellen bieten.

Du suchst einen Praktikumsplatz, in dem du von Anfang an in ein echtes Kundenprojekt einsteigst, mit modernen Automatisierungstools arbeitest und dabei wirklich etwas bewegst? Dann wird DIU interessant für dich. Bei uns gibt es keine politischen Abstimmungen und langen Wege – transparent, professionell, intelligent. Als Praktikant (m/w/d) RPA-Automatisierung im Marketing arbeitest du aktiv am Aufbau der RPA-Lösung für unseren Kunden mit: Du modellierst Automatisierungsprozesse in Blue Prism, verstehst Prozesslogik und bringst dich bei Code Reviews mit dem RPA-Team des Kunden ein.

Wir suchen dich für ein Vollzeit-Praktikum von 3–6 Monaten – remote oder mit optionaler Präsenz in Hamburg, wo wir uns derzeit etwa einmal wöchentlich im Büro treffen. Du arbeitest eng mit einer erfahrenen Integratorin zusammen, die dich einarbeitet und begleitet, und bist von Beginn an Teil unseres MarTech-Teams an den Standorten Hamburg und Wiesbaden. Für Studierende mit Leidenschaft fürs Thema besteht nach dem Praktikum die Möglichkeit zur Weiterbeschäftigung als Werkstudent:in.

DOINGS

  • Du überführst Automatisierungsanforderungen aus dem Kundenbriefing in Blue-Prism-Prozesse und entwickelst sie bis zur lauffähigen Lösung.

  • Du pflegst und erweiterst bestehende Blue-Prism-Workflows und bringst dich aktiv in die laufende Lösungsentwicklung ein.

  • Du nutzt KI-gestützte Tools wie Claude und MCP-Server als ergänzendes Werkzeug im Projektalltag.

  • Du arbeitest mit CMS-Systemen und verstehst, wie Schnittstellen funktionieren – auch dort, wo APIs fehlen.

  • Du nimmst an Code Reviews mit dem RPA-Entwicklerteam des Kunden teil und verstehst, was hinter den Code Stages steckt.

  • Du dokumentierst Prozesse, Workflows und Lösungsansätze strukturiert für Team und Kunden.

  • Du testest automatisierte Prozesse, analysierst Fehler und bringst Verbesserungen ein.

  • Du stimmst dich regelmäßig mit dem Team und den Ansprechpartner:innen beim Kunden ab.

Qualifikation

KNOWHOW

  • Laufendes Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informationswissenschaft, Digital Business oder eines vergleichbaren technisch-digitalen Studiengangs.

  • Bei einer Praktikumsdauer über 3 Monate: Pflichtpraktikum im Rahmen deiner Studien- und Prüfungsordnung.

  • Du kannst Code lesen und verstehen – idealerweise C#; du musst nicht selbst entwickeln, aber nachvollziehen können, was passiert.

  • Interesse an Prozessautomatisierung und Lust, dich schnell in Blue Prism einzuarbeiten; erste Erfahrungen mit RPA oder ähnlichen Automatisierungstools sind von Vorteil.

  • Verständnis für digitale Systemlandschaften und Schnittstellen; Erfahrungen mit APIs, Middlewares oder CMS-Systemen sind ein Plus.

  • Offenheit für KI-gestützte Tools wie Claude und MCP-Server – oder bereits erste Erfahrungen damit.

  • Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, auch in einem laufenden Projekt schnell mitzudenken.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

DIU FOR YOU

Bei DIU besetzen wir nicht Stellen, sondern suchen nach Menschen mit Leidenschaft für ihr Fachgebiet. Wir verstehen uns als Plattform für ein Team aus Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft mit anderen teilen oder in Projekte einbringen möchten. Den Rahmen für diese Arbeit schaffen wir mit:

  • Einarbeitung und enger Begleitung durch eine erfahrene Integratorin im Projekt

  • Echter Projektverantwortung vom ersten Tag an

  • Praktikumsvergütung von €900–1.300/Monat brutto, je nach Vorerfahrung

  • Aussicht auf eine Werkstudentenstelle nach dem Praktikum

  • Einer agilen Unternehmensorganisation

  • Einer offenen Fehler- und Gesprächskultur

  • Vergünstigtes Deutschlandticket über Gehaltsumwandlung

DIU SPIRIT

Wir sind nicht laut - sondern lieber unaufgeregt und verlässlich. Wir entwickeln DIU bewusst strukturiert weiter. Bei uns findest du:

  • Sehr durchmischte Altersstrukturen

  • Moderne technische Infrastruktur und Tools

  • Teilzeitmodelle unterschiedlicher Art

GET IN

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, selbst wenn dein Profil nicht exakt auf die Beschreibung passt. Bewirb dich jetzt einfach und unkompliziert über das Bewerbungsformular und unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Starttermins, deines gewünschten Praktikumszeitraums sowie deiner Vergütungsvorstellung.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Construction
description:
About XYZ Reality


XYZ Reality created the world’s first engineering-grade augmented reality for construction. Our site-safe hardhat, The Atom, overlays the design model onto the live build, so our engineers can verify work as it goes in on some of the most complex mission-critical projects in the world.

Growing fast across the US, UK and Europe, we’re a driven, passionate team changing how the industry builds.

If you want your work to shape how the world gets built, we’d like to hear from you.

Location: UK (Remote)

 

ABOUT XYZ REALITY

──────────────────────────────

XYZ Reality are the creators of the world's first and only engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution, purpose built for the construction industry. Not only have we created this holographic technology, that sits within The Atom, a smart, site-safe headset/hardhat, but we implement it on projects, utilising the power of AR to ensure that all schemes are completed in line with delivery timescales and budgets.

 

XYZ has grown to over 100 staff across the UK, US & Europe and is working with Mission Critical organisations & construction companies to successfully deliver major projects.

 

THE ROLE

──────────────────────────────

As an Account Executive, you'll drive new revenue in data centre construction, owning your accounts from first conversation through to expansion.

 

You'll act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, making the business case for XYZ Reality's engineering-grade AR in terms of ROI, risk reduction and delivery certainty, and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles through to close.

 

You'll carry annual and quarterly targets as a core member of our growing revenue team.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

──────────────────────────────

• Own and grow a portfolio of data centre accounts, from winning new business to expanding existing customers, with clear account plans aligned to revenue targets.

• Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles end to end - prospecting, qualification, solution alignment, commercial negotiation and close.

• Build relationships from site teams through to the C-suite, positioning XYZ Reality as a strategic partner rather than a technology vendor.

• Turn customer delivery and cost challenges into compelling business cases that demonstrate ROI, risk reduction and operational impact.

• Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success and Project Delivery so that what we sell is what gets delivered on site, with a smooth handover after close.

• Build your own pipeline within your accounts, keep accurate forecasts and records in Salesforce, and support RFPs and formal bids, where required.

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

──────────────────────────────

  1. Proven experience owning complex, enterprise sales cycles with annual quotas.

  2. Track record of closing six-figure-plus deals with multiple stakeholders and long decision cycles.

  3. Strong experience in value-based and solution selling, including account planning.

  4. Willing and able to travel domestically and internationally for meetings, demos and site visits.

 

KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

──────────────────────────────

  1. Experience selling into data centre construction or other mission-critical environments.

  2. Background in construction technology, SaaS or cloud-based solutions.

  3. Comfortable engaging senior executives while also working on site with delivery teams.

  4. Excellent communication across technical and non-technical audiences.

  5. CRM discipline, ideally Salesforce, and comfort working within structured sales processes.

  6. Proactive, coachable and energised by building long-term customer relationships.

 

BENEFITS

──────────────────────────────

💰 Market leading OTE

🩺 Private healthcare

🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays

🎄 Extra Christmas shutdown days

🥳 Summer & Christmas staff parties

🚀 Make a real-world impact of revolutionising the construction industry

title: High Voltage Electrical Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will tackle some of the most demanding high-voltage engineering challenges in the energy industry, developing electrical systems that enable next-generation plasma heating technologies. Your expertise will directly influence the performance, reliability, and safety of critical plant systems, shaping the electrical backbone of a first-of-a-kind fusion power plant. By advancing high-voltage power conversion, insulation, protection, and system integration, you will help transform cutting-edge scientific concepts into industrial-scale reality.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Lead the engineering and integration of high-voltage power systems supporting critical plant operations

  • Define high-voltage electrical architectures, simulate power conversion and selection of electrical components

  • Perform and review key electrical studies, including insulation coordination, transient overvoltage, short-circuit protection, grounding, and safety analyses

  • Develop strategies for high-voltage system monitoring, diagnostics, and condition assessment to improve reliability and maintainability

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of high-voltage systems with plant infrastructure and control systems

  • Oversee testing, commissioning, and validation activities for high-voltage equipment and subsystems

  • Build a safety culture that protects our people first and equipment second, from the dangers inherent in high voltage systems

WHO YOU ARE

  • You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field

  • You have experience designing, analyzing, or commissioning high-voltage electrical systems in industrial, utility, research, or energy applications

  • You enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and developing innovative solutions where established approaches may not yet exist

  • Experience in the design and application of insulation systems, electric field management, and creepage and clearance coordination is a plus

  • Familiarity with protection systems, interlocking philosophies, and functional safety concepts for high-energy electrical installations is a plus

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Ownership: As an early member of a growing team, you’ll help define how we test HTS at scale.

  • Development: Build specialist skills at the cutting edge of superconducting magnet technology.


    WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Qualification at Scale

  • Test Planning: Define test strategies, sampling plans and pass/fail criteria for HTS tapes and cables, and help set up production testing at our Magnet Factory.

  • Measurement: Commission test systems and develop measurement processes that ensure reproducible, traceable measurements of critical current (Ic) and related properties, including the effects of manufacturing processes.

  • Data & Statistics: Help design our HTS test database, with traceability from supplier and reel through to cable, and turn results into statistical datasets for magnet modelling and design.

  • Supplier Selection: Compare supplier data with our own measurements and support decisions on which tapes to use in Alpha and future stellarators.

2. R&D

  • HTS Qualification: Run tape and cable qualification test campaigns, both in-house and at external facilities.

  • Analysis & Reporting: Compare results with models and give clear technical recommendations to the design, modelling and manufacturing teams.

  • Equipment Development: Support the development of new test equipment and methods with external partners.

3. Planning, Safety & Team

  • Planning: Plan test campaigns in line with tape deliveries and the Alpha build programme.

  • Technician Guidance: Write procedures and guide the technicians who run routine tests.

  • Safety: Ensure safe work with cryogens, high currents and high magnetic fields.

  • Quality: Ensure results are traceable, well documented and reproducible.

WHO YOU ARE

An engineer or scientist who enjoys careful, hands-on experimental work as much as planning how we test at scale.

  • You hold an MSc or PhD in Physics, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

  • You have hands-on experience characterising materials or devices, and are comfortable designing experiments.

  • You speak fluent English.

  • You have strong data analysis skills and a solid grasp of measurement uncertainty and statistics.

  • You are happy to travel for test campaigns at external facilities, including internationally.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with superconductors, cryogenics or high magnetic fields.

  • Experience with quality control or production testing at scale.

  • Experience designing cryogenic or automated test equipment.

  • Familiarity with HTS tape manufacturing processes and the supplier landscape.

  • German language skills.

This role will initially be based in our Zurich office. As the project develops, the position may move to Germany. If that happens, we’ll give you at least six months’ notice and support you through the move.

title: Account Executive - Enterprise, Spotify Technology
description:
Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.

As an Account Executive on our Enterprise team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on organizations with 1,000+ employees, where engineering environments are complex, buying committees span engineering, finance, procurement, security, and legal, and large deals can take many months to close. Success in this role comes from long-term strategy: building account plans, developing deep relationships, and positioning our products as a strategic investment in how large engineering organizations work.

You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to close new business, expand existing customer relationships, and cross-sell products across our portfolio. Your ability to understand both the technical depth of our products and the strategic priorities of senior engineering and business leaders will be key to your success.

What You'll Do

• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with organizations of 1,000+ employees. This is a “Hunter” role with significant inbound and SDR support.

• Research and prospect into target accounts, building strategic account plans that map stakeholders, priorities, and opportunities for long-term growth.

• Lead complex enterprise sales cycles, proactively engaging multiple stakeholders, including CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Product leaders, platform teams, developer experience leaders, procurement, security, and legal.

• Build multi-threaded relationships across each account and develop multiple internal champions to secure new deals and support expansion over time.

• Achieve and exceed revenue targets while maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast data for long-cycle deals.

• Structure and negotiate agreements that support customer adoption, expansion, and long-term success.

• Articulate how Backstage Portal and Confidence solve developer experience challenges at scale, including how AI is reshaping software development in large organizations.

• Tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale.

• Build business cases and return-on-investment (ROI) narratives that resonate with executive buyers.

• Partner closely with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and integration planning.

• Collaborate with Customer Success to support retention and identify expansion opportunities across business units, while sharing customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.

• Travel up to 30% of the time to meet existing and prospective customers in your regional market, strengthen relationships, and support business growth.

Who You Are

• You have 5+ years of experience in a quota-carrying sales role, including experience selling enterprise software, ideally in SaaS, developer platforms, or cloud services.

• You have a proven track record of closing large, complex enterprise deals and achieving or exceeding revenue targets.

• You are experienced in strategic account planning, building multi-threaded relationships, and navigating long sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.

• You have experience selling to technical and executive stakeholders, such as CTOs, VPs of Engineering, platform teams, and DevOps leaders.

• You are familiar with software development, DevOps tools, or developer ecosystems, and understand how engineering organizations make buying decisions.

• You are comfortable managing procurement processes, security reviews, and legal negotiations for multi-year agreements.

• You can translate technical value into business outcomes and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• You bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills, along with a strategic approach to long-term account development.

• You are excited to help build a scalable sales motion with AI and enjoy working with innovative products in an evolving technology landscape.

Where You'll Be

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best!

For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location.
This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.

Compensation

Additional Information

The United States base range for this position is $110,392-157,704 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. title: Mechanical Designer - 6 months contract
description:
SYSTRA Canada is part of the SYSTRA group, an international consulting and engineering group, a world leader in the design of transport infrastructures. SYSTRA Canada is an engineering and consulting firm whose primary focus is to offer transportation solutions, whether for passengers or goods: feasibility studies of building a new railway line, increasing the capacity of the existing infrastructure, privatization of a railway.

Context

The Mechanical Designer will design structures, interior finishes, and various systems and components for rail vehicles, including locomotives, passenger cars, freight wagons, and maintenance equipment. They will produce designs using SolidWorks, SolidWorks PDM, and occasionally DraftSight.

Missions/Main Duties

  • Design and modify structures, equipment, and interior fittings for rail vehicles, including component layouts, supporting brackets, and fastening systems in compliance with standards and project requirements.
  • Create bolted, welded, and sheet metal assemblies using various materials (steel, stainless steel, aluminum), and develop sheet metal patterns/models.
  • Design plastic and composite components and select hardware items per engineering direction.
  • Prepare material lists and produce detailed drawings for modification, manufacturing, assembly, and installation.
  • Develop assembly manuals and installation instructions.
  • Conduct dimensional surveys on-site or in the workshop to support manufacturing and installation.

Profile/Skills

Education: College diploma (DEC) in mechanical design or Bachelor's degree in Engineering.

Years of experience: 5-10 years experience in metal fabrication and mechanical design, including significant experience with Inventor or Solidworks 3D modeling software (Relevant experience with other modeling software may be considered equivalent).

Technical skills:

description:
About the Role

Boogie Team is recruiting a reliable, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to support day-to-day financial operations for U.S.-based clients.

You will maintain accurate books, reconcile accounts, support accounts payable and receivable, and prepare useful financial reports.

Remote work aligned with U.S. Pacific Time (Los Angeles, PST/PDT), including daylight saving changes. The exact shift, working days, weekly hours, compensation, and engagement terms will be confirmed for the assignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Record and categorize transactions accurately.
  • Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and other financial accounts.
  • Manage invoices, bills, payments, outstanding balances, and expense records.
  • Prepare profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash-flow reports.
  • Support month-end closing, financial documentation, and tax-preparation requests.
  • Communicate with clients, vendors, and accounting teams to resolve discrepancies.

Requirements

  • At least two years of hands-on bookkeeping experience supporting U.S. businesses or clients.
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online and a solid understanding of U.S. bookkeeping practices.
